title: Tenant
description: The tenant contract. One file per tenant in tenants/, named <name>.yaml.

group.description: A group name. A colon is not allowed, so system:masters and similar built-in groups cannot be requested.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Always 1 for now.

name.description: Tenant name. Must equal the file name without .yaml. The namespace is tenant-<name>.

team.description: Short team identifier. It is used as a label on every resource.

email.description: Contact address. A team list is better than a person.

costCentre.description: Cost centre code. It is used as a label for cost showback.

environment.description: Environment this tenant is used for. It is used as a label.

size.description: Size tier. It decides the resource quota of the namespace.

admins.description: Groups with full control inside the tenant namespace only.

viewers.description: Groups with read-only access inside the tenant namespace.
